name: Smart AI Forms – AI Form Builder for WordPress
author: cpimediabhushan

sections.description:
Smart AI Forms is the fastest way to build WordPress forms. Just type what you need in plain English — “create a job application form with file upload” — and the AI builds it instantly. No templates to browse, no fields to drag one by one.

Unlike every other AI form plugin, you don’t need an OpenAI API key. We handle the AI on our secure servers. Install, activate, and start generating forms in under 60 seconds.

Why Smart AI Forms?

Most form builders make you start from scratch every time. Smart AI Forms lets you describe the form you want and get a fully built, editable form in seconds. It’s the only WordPress form builder built for the AI era.

“Smart AI Form is best from all the remaining and it’s pro version is best among all the wordpress form.”
— saurabhsd, verified user ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

FREE VERSION FEATURES

✅ AI-Assisted Form Builder – Drag-and-drop builder with real-time preview
✅ Unlimited Forms – Create as many forms as you need, no limits
✅ Unlimited Fields – Text, email, phone, dropdown, radio, checkbox, HTML, divider
✅ Email Notifications – Get notified instantly on every new submission
✅ CSV Export – Download all entries with one click
✅ 100% Responsive – Forms look great on desktop, tablet, and mobile
✅ Gutenberg Block – Embed forms anywhere with the Smart AI Form block
✅ No Coding Required – Works out of the box for anyone

PRO VERSION FEATURES

🚀 Prompt-to-Form AI Generation – Describe your form in plain English, AI builds it in seconds
🚀 No API Key Needed – AI works instantly, no OpenAI account or setup required
🚀 Conditional Logic – Show or hide fields based on user answers
🚀 Payment Fields – Accept payments via Stripe and PayPal directly in your forms
🚀 File Upload Field – Let users attach documents, images, and files
🚀 AI Dropdown Options – Auto-generate relevant dropdown choices based on form context
🚀 Layout Field Designer – Multi-column drag-and-drop layouts
🚀 Premium Support – Priority email support

👉 Get Smart AI Forms Pro

PERFECT FOR

  • Contact forms – Replace basic contact forms with AI-generated smart forms
  • Lead generation forms – Capture leads with conditional logic that adapts to each visitor
  • Job application forms – Accept resumes and documents with file upload
  • Payment forms – Sell products or services with Stripe and PayPal integration
  • Survey forms – Build surveys with AI-generated dropdown options
  • Booking forms – Create appointment and booking forms in seconds
  • Registration forms – Event and membership registration made easy

HOW THE AI WORKS

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Smart AI Forms → Add New Form
  3. In the Pro version, type your prompt: “Create a catering order form with dietary preferences and payment”
  4. The AI generates all fields, labels, and structure instantly
  5. Edit anything with drag-and-drop
  6. Publish and embed with a shortcode or Gutenberg block

The AI runs on our secure servers — no OpenAI account, no API key, no extra cost.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the smart-ai-forms-lite folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Navigate to Smart AI Forms → Add New Form in your dashboard
  4. Build your form using the drag-and-drop builder
  5. Save and copy the shortcode (e.g. [smaraifo_form id="123"])
  6. Paste the shortcode into any post, page, or widget
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API key?

No. The AI features in Smart AI Forms Pro run on our own secure servers. You don’t need any external accounts, API keys, or technical setup. Just install and go.

How does the AI form generation work?

In the Pro version, simply type what you need in the prompt box — for example, “create a job application form with CV upload and salary expectations”. The AI analyzes your request and generates all the appropriate fields, labels, and structure in seconds. You can then edit anything with drag-and-drop.

How do I embed a form on my site?

After creating your form, copy the shortcode shown at the top of the form builder (it looks like [smaraifo_form id="123"]). Paste it into any post, page, or widget. You can also use the Smart AI Form Gutenberg block to embed it directly in the block editor.

Will this slow down my WordPress site?

No. The AI generation happens server-side only when you’re building a form — it has zero impact on your site’s frontend performance. The forms themselves are lightweight and load fast.

Can I use Stripe and PayPal at the same time?

Yes, with Pro you can offer both payment gateways on a single form, giving your visitors more payment options and improving conversion rates.

Does the free version include AI form generation?

The AI prompt-to-form feature is available in the Pro version. The free version includes a full drag-and-drop form builder with all essential field types.

Will my forms still work after upgrading to Pro?

Yes. Install the Pro plugin alongside the Lite version. Pro will automatically detect your existing forms and enhance them with Pro features. We recommend deactivating the Lite plugin after activating Pro to avoid duplicate menu items.

How many forms can I create?

Unlimited, in both the free and Pro versions.

Is it GDPR compliant?

Yes. Smart AI Forms does not send any user submission data to external servers. All form entries are stored in your own WordPress database.
